question: All men are mortal. Socrates is a man. Which of the following is true?
solution: The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/732531f41578348d711ff8bdab140cd78dff238492ecbbbdbf21a6a2326d474e.png] Conclusions: Option 1) Socrates is not mortal → Does not follow (As all men are mortal and Socrates is a man.
